examples.en: Our family has a reunion every Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 我們家每年農曆新年都會團圓。

examples.en: She cried happily at the reunion with her old friends.
examples.zh: 她和老朋友重逢時開心地哭了。

examples.en: The class reunion will be held at a restaurant next month.
examples.zh: 同學會下個月會在一間餐廳舉行。

examples.en: I could hear the sincerity in her voice.
examples.zh: 我聽得出她聲音裡的真誠。

examples.en: He thanked the teacher with great sincerity.
examples.zh: 他非常誠懇地感謝老師。

examples.en: Nobody doubted the sincerity of his apology.
examples.zh: 沒有人懷疑他道歉的誠意。

examples.en: This statistic shows how many students ride bikes to school.
examples.zh: 這個統計數字顯示有多少學生騎腳踏車上學。

examples.en: The report includes a surprising statistic about sleep.
examples.zh: 這份報告包含一個關於睡眠的驚人統計數字。

examples.en: One statistic says that most customers shop online.
examples.zh: 有一項統計指出，大部分顧客都在網路上購物。

examples.en: The zebra has black and white stripes.
examples.zh: 斑馬身上有黑白相間的條紋。

examples.en: She bought a shirt with blue stripes.
examples.zh: 她買了一件藍色條紋的襯衫。

examples.en: The white stripes on the road mark the pedestrian crossing.
examples.zh: 馬路上的白色條紋標示出斑馬線的位置。

examples.en: The customer decided to sue the company for the broken phone.
examples.zh: 那位顧客決定因為壞掉的手機而控告那家公司。

examples.en: They threatened to sue the landlord over the deposit that was never returned.
examples.zh: 他們威脅要為了未退還的押金控告房東。

examples.en: You can sue if the store refuses to give you a refund.
examples.zh: 如果商店拒絕退款，你可以提起訴訟。

examples.en: The trees sway gently in the evening breeze.
examples.zh: 樹木在傍晚的微風中輕輕搖擺。

examples.en: The passengers swayed as the bus turned the corner.
examples.zh: 公車轉彎時，乘客跟著搖晃。

examples.en: Her speech helped sway the voters in the class election.
examples.zh: 她的演說有助於影響班上選舉的選民。

examples.en: The sway of the boat made me feel sick.
examples.zh: 船的搖擺讓我覺得想吐。

examples.en: The old tradition still holds sway over life in the village.
examples.zh: 這項古老的傳統仍支配著村裡的生活。

examples.en: We watched the slow sway of the tall grass.
examples.zh: 我們看著高高的草緩緩搖擺。

examples.en: Waiting for the test results was pure torture.
examples.zh: 等待考試成績簡直是一種煎熬。

examples.en: Sitting through a three-hour meeting felt like torture.
examples.zh: 坐著開完三小時的會議像是一種折磨。

examples.en: The history lesson explained why torture is prohibited under international law.
examples.zh: 這堂歷史課說明了為什麼國際法禁止酷刑。

examples.en: The museum has a collection of tribal masks.
examples.zh: 博物館有一批部落面具的收藏。

examples.en: Tribal leaders met to discuss the future of their land.
examples.zh: 部落領袖聚在一起討論他們土地的未來。

examples.en: We listened to tribal music at the cultural festival.
examples.zh: 我們在文化節聽了部落音樂。

examples.en: The company has a vacancy for a new designer.
examples.zh: 這家公司有一個新設計師的職缺。

examples.en: The hotel sign said there was no vacancy tonight.
examples.zh: 飯店的告示牌寫著今晚沒有空房。

examples.en: We have a vacancy in our club, so please join us.
examples.zh: 我們社團有個空缺，歡迎你加入。

examples.en: A friendly workplace makes everyone feel comfortable.
examples.zh: 友善的工作環境讓每個人都覺得自在。

examples.en: Safety rules are posted all over the workplace.
examples.zh: 工作場所到處都張貼著安全規定。

examples.en: She learned many useful skills in her first workplace.
examples.zh: 她在第一個職場學到許多實用的技能。

examples.en: The calculation took me only a few minutes.
examples.zh: 這個計算只花了我幾分鐘。

examples.en: My calculation shows that the trip will cost about NT$5,000.
examples.zh: 我的估算顯示這趟旅行大約要花新台幣五千元。

examples.en: Please check your calculation again before you hand it in.
examples.zh: 交出去之前，請再檢查一次你的計算。

examples.en: I found a nice lamp in the furniture catalogue.
examples.zh: 我在家具型錄裡找到一盞很棒的檯燈。

examples.en: The library catalogue lists every book on the shelves.
examples.zh: 圖書館目錄列出書架上的每一本書。

examples.en: The store will send you a free catalogue by mail.
examples.zh: 這家店會用郵寄方式寄給你一本免費型錄。

examples.en: The librarian will catalogue all the new books this week.
examples.zh: 圖書館員這週會把所有新書編入目錄。

examples.en: Volunteers helped catalogue the museum's old photographs.
examples.zh: 志工協助將博物館的老照片編入目錄。

examples.en: She spent the weekend cataloguing her stamp collection.
examples.zh: 她花了一個週末把她的郵票收藏編成目錄。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my earphones to the gym.
examples.zh: 我忘了把耳機帶去健身房。

examples.en: One earphone stopped working after a week.
examples.zh: 有一邊耳機用了一個星期就壞了。

examples.en: Please use an earphone when you watch videos on the train.
examples.zh: 在火車上看影片時，請使用耳機。

examples.en: The museum teaches students about the invasion of ancient cities.
examples.zh: 博物館教導學生古代城市遭入侵的歷史。

examples.en: Reading my diary is an invasion of my privacy.
examples.zh: 偷看我的日記是侵犯我的隱私。

examples.en: Farmers worried about an invasion of insects this summer.
examples.zh: 農民擔心今年夏天會有昆蟲大量入侵。

examples.en: Long ago, people sent news by telegraph.
examples.zh: 很久以前，人們用電報傳遞消息。

examples.en: The museum has an old telegraph from the 1800s.
examples.zh: 博物館有一台十九世紀的舊電報機。

examples.en: The telegraph let people send messages across the country quickly.
examples.zh: 電報讓人們能迅速把訊息傳到全國各地。

examples.en: We visited an old abbey during our trip to England.
examples.zh: 我們到英國旅行時參觀了一座古老的修道院。

examples.en: The abbey is famous for its beautiful stone walls.
examples.zh: 這座修道院以美麗的石牆聞名。

examples.en: Monks have lived in this abbey for hundreds of years.
examples.zh: 修士們在這座修道院裡住了幾百年。

examples.en: "Dr." is a common abbreviation for the word "doctor".
examples.zh: 「Dr.」是「doctor」這個字的常見縮寫。

examples.en: What is the abbreviation for Taipei Main Station?
examples.zh: 台北車站的縮寫是什麼？

examples.en: Please write the full word instead of using an abbreviation.
examples.zh: 請寫出完整的字，不要使用縮寫。

examples.en: The doctor pressed gently on my abdomen.
examples.zh: 醫生輕輕按壓我的腹部。

examples.en: She felt a sharp pain in her lower abdomen.
examples.zh: 她覺得下腹部一陣劇痛。

examples.en: An insect's body consists of a head, a thorax, and an abdomen.
examples.zh: 昆蟲的身體由頭部、胸部和腹部組成。

examples.en: The old textbook uses the term aborigine for Australia's original inhabitants.
examples.zh: 這本舊課本用 aborigine 一詞稱呼澳洲的原住民。

examples.en: The nineteenth-century diary describes an aborigine guiding explorers through the forest.
examples.zh: 這本十九世紀的日記描述一位原住民帶領探險家穿越森林。

examples.en: The old book records stories that an aborigine shared with travelers.
examples.zh: 這本舊書記錄了一位原住民與旅人分享的故事。

examples.en: My absent-minded uncle often forgets where he put his keys.
examples.zh: 我那心不在焉的叔叔常常忘記把鑰匙放哪裡。

examples.en: She was so absent-minded that she wore two different shoes.
examples.zh: 她太心不在焉，結果穿了兩隻不一樣的鞋子。

examples.en: The absent-minded student left his lunch box on the bus.
examples.zh: 那個心不在焉的學生把便當盒忘在公車上。

examples.en: The car's quick acceleration surprised the driver.
examples.zh: 這輛車加速很快，讓駕駛嚇了一跳。

examples.en: Our science class measured the acceleration of a rolling ball.
examples.zh: 我們的自然課測量了滾動的球的加速度。

examples.en: The acceleration of the train was smooth and quiet.
examples.zh: 火車的加速平穩又安靜。

examples.en: She is an accomplished pianist who plays around the world.
examples.zh: 她是一位技藝高超的鋼琴家，在世界各地演奏。

examples.en: My aunt is an accomplished cook who teaches at a culinary school.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是一位廚藝高超的廚師，在烹飪學校教書。

examples.en: He became an accomplished writer before the age of thirty.
examples.zh: 他在三十歲前就成為一位有成就的作家。

examples.en: I am not accustomed to waking up so early.
examples.zh: 我不習慣這麼早起床。

examples.en: She soon became accustomed to the busy city life.
examples.zh: 她很快就習慣了繁忙的都市生活。

examples.en: Many students are accustomed to studying with music on.
examples.zh: 許多學生習慣邊聽音樂邊讀書。

senses.zh: 王牌；高手；撲克牌的 A

examples.en: He is the ace of our school baseball team.
examples.zh: 他是我們學校棒球隊的王牌。

examples.en: Lily drew the ace of hearts in the card game.
examples.zh: 莉莉在紙牌遊戲中抽到了紅心 A。

examples.en: My sister is an ace at solving math problems.
examples.zh: 我姊姊是解數學題目的高手。

examples.en: She is an ace pilot with years of experience.
examples.zh: 她是一位有多年經驗的一流飛行員。

examples.en: The ace reporter wrote the best story of the year.
examples.zh: 這位頂尖記者寫出了年度最佳報導。

examples.en: They hired an ace designer for the new shop.
examples.zh: 他們為新店請了一位一流的設計師。

senses.zh: 聲音的；原聲的；非電子的

examples.en: He plays an acoustic guitar in the school band.
examples.zh: 他在學校樂團彈木吉他。

examples.en: The hall has excellent acoustic quality for concerts.
examples.zh: 這間禮堂的音響效果很適合辦音樂會。

examples.en: The singer gave an acoustic performance without any speakers.
examples.zh: 那位歌手不用任何喇叭，進行了一場原聲演出。

examples.en: She dreams of a career in acting.
examples.zh: 她夢想從事演戲的工作。

examples.en: His acting in the school play was wonderful.
examples.zh: 他在學校話劇中的演出很精彩。

examples.en: Acting classes helped him feel less nervous on stage.
examples.zh: 表演課幫助他在台上不再那麼緊張。

examples.en: The acting principal welcomed us to the new school year.
examples.zh: 代理校長歡迎我們來到新學年。

examples.en: Mr. Chen is the acting manager while Ms. Lin is away.
examples.zh: 林小姐不在時，陳先生擔任代理經理。

examples.en: The acting director will sign the document on Monday.
examples.zh: 代理主任星期一會在文件上簽名。

examples.en: Press this button to activate the alarm.
examples.zh: 按下這個按鈕來啟動警報器。

examples.en: You need to activate your new phone card first.
examples.zh: 你必須先啟用你的新電話卡。

examples.en: The motion sensor will activate the lights when you walk in.
examples.zh: 你走進來時，動作感應器會啟動燈光。

examples.en: Many teenagers are addicted to their phones.
examples.zh: 許多青少年對手機上癮。

examples.en: My brother is addicted to this video game.
examples.zh: 我弟弟沉迷於這款電玩。

examples.en: She got addicted to sweet drinks during the summer.
examples.zh: 她在夏天對含糖飲料上了癮。

examples.en: This juice contains no artificial additives, according to the label.
examples.zh: 根據標示，這種果汁不含人工添加物。

examples.en: Check the label for any additive you are allergic to.
examples.zh: 請看標籤上有沒有你會過敏的添加物。

examples.en: A food additive can help bread stay fresh longer.
examples.zh: 食品添加物可以讓麵包保存得更久。

examples.en: The sticker will adhere to any clean, flat surface.
examples.zh: 這張貼紙可以黏附在任何乾淨的平面上。

examples.en: All students must adhere to the school rules.
examples.zh: 所有學生都必須遵守校規。

examples.en: She adheres to a strict study plan every week.
examples.zh: 她每週都遵循嚴格的讀書計畫。

examples.en: Our classroom is adjacent to the library.
examples.zh: 我們的教室緊鄰圖書館。

examples.en: The hotel has two adjacent rooms for families.
examples.zh: 這間飯店有兩間相鄰的房間供家庭使用。

examples.en: A small park is adjacent to the school gate.
examples.zh: 一座小公園就在校門旁邊。

examples.en: The kitchen adjoins the dining room, making it easy to serve meals.
examples.zh: 廚房緊鄰餐廳，方便上菜。

examples.en: Our garden adjoins a quiet park where local children often play.
examples.zh: 我們家的花園緊鄰一座安靜的公園，當地小孩常在那裡玩耍。

examples.en: The two rooms adjoin, with a connecting door between them.
examples.zh: 這兩間房間相鄰，中間設有一道連通門。

examples.en: The mechanic made a small adjustment to the bike seat.
examples.zh: 技師對腳踏車座椅做了一個小調整。

examples.en: Moving to a new school requires some adjustment.
examples.zh: 轉到新學校需要一些適應。

examples.en: We made an adjustment to the schedule because of the typhoon.
examples.zh: 因為颱風，我們調整了時程表。

examples.en: Adulthood brings new freedom and new responsibilities.
examples.zh: 成年期帶來新的自由與新的責任。

examples.en: Many people move out of their parents' home in early adulthood.
examples.zh: 許多人在成年初期就搬出父母的家。

examples.en: He reached adulthood and began to plan his own future.
examples.zh: 他成年了，開始規劃自己的未來。

examples.en: Advancement in technology has changed the way we live.
examples.zh: 科技的進步改變了我們的生活方式。

examples.en: She worked hard for her advancement at the company.
examples.zh: 她為了在公司的晉升而努力工作。

examples.en: The school supports the advancement of every student.
examples.zh: 學校支持每位學生的進步。

examples.en: The advent of smartphones changed how we take photos.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機的出現改變了我們拍照的方式。

examples.en: The advent of spring brings warmer weather.
examples.zh: 春天的來臨帶來較溫暖的天氣。

examples.en: Online shopping grew quickly after the advent of the internet.
examples.zh: 網路出現後，網路購物迅速成長。

examples.en: In "She ran quickly," the word "quickly" is an adverb.
examples.zh: 在「She ran quickly」這個句子中，quickly 是副詞。

examples.en: Our English teacher asked us to underline each adverb.
examples.zh: 英文老師要我們把每個副詞畫上底線。

examples.en: An adverb can describe a verb, an adjective, or another adverb.
examples.zh: 副詞可以修飾動詞、形容詞或另一個副詞。

examples.en: I saw an advert for a new bakery on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公車上看到一則新麵包店的廣告。

examples.en: The advert on TV made me hungry.
examples.zh: 電視上的廣告讓我肚子餓了。

examples.en: She answered an advert for a part-time job.
examples.zh: 她應徵了廣告上的兼職工作。

examples.en: The advertiser paid for a full page in the magazine.
examples.zh: 廣告商付錢買下雜誌的整頁版面。

examples.en: Every advertiser wants to reach more young customers.
examples.zh: 每位廣告商都想接觸更多年輕顧客。

examples.en: The website earns money from advertisers who pay for banner space.
examples.zh: 這個網站從付費購買橫幅廣告版位的廣告主取得收入。

examples.en: Advertising helps companies sell their products and attract new customers.
examples.zh: 廣告幫助公司銷售產品，並吸引新顧客。

examples.en: She works in advertising and designs posters for stores.
examples.zh: 她在廣告業工作，為商店設計海報。

examples.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising every year.
examples.zh: 這家公司每年花很多錢在廣告上。

examples.en: It is advisable to bring an umbrella in the rainy season.
examples.zh: 雨季帶把傘是明智的。

examples.en: Doctors say it is advisable to drink more water.
examples.zh: 醫生說多喝水是可取的。

examples.en: Is it advisable to travel during the holiday?
examples.zh: 假期期間出遊明智嗎？

examples.en: The aerial photo shows the whole city.
examples.zh: 這張空拍照片呈現了整座城市。

examples.en: We enjoyed an aerial view of the mountains from the plane.
examples.zh: 我們從飛機上欣賞山脈的空中景色。

examples.en: The team used an aerial camera to film the festival.
examples.zh: 團隊用空拍攝影機拍攝這場慶典。

examples.en: Dad fixed the aerial on the roof so the TV works again.
examples.zh: 爸爸修好屋頂上的天線，電視又能看了。

examples.en: The old radio has a long metal aerial.
examples.zh: 那台舊收音機有一根長長的金屬天線。

examples.en: Strong wind bent the aerial on our car.
examples.zh: 強風把我們車上的天線吹彎了。

examples.en: My uncle works in the aerospace industry.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在航太產業工作。

examples.en: She wants to study aerospace engineering at university.
examples.zh: 她想在大學主修航太工程。

examples.en: Aerospace companies build planes and spacecraft for commercial and scientific use.
examples.zh: 航太公司製造商業與科學用途的飛機和太空船。

examples.en: The designer cares a lot about the aesthetics of the room.
examples.zh: 設計師非常重視房間的美感。

examples.en: Aesthetics is a popular class in the art department.
examples.zh: 美學是藝術系一門熱門的課。

examples.en: Simple lines are important in modern aesthetics.
examples.zh: 簡潔的線條在現代美學中很重要。

examples.en: Back pain afflicts many office workers who sit for long periods.
examples.zh: 背痛困擾著許多久坐的上班族。

examples.en: The village has been afflicted by hot, dry weather.
examples.zh: 這座村莊飽受炎熱乾燥的天氣之苦。

examples.en: Allergies afflict millions of people every spring.
examples.zh: 過敏在每年春天困擾著數百萬人。

examples.en: In the aftermath of the typhoon, neighbors helped clean the streets.
examples.zh: 颱風過後，鄰居們幫忙清理街道。

examples.en: The school reviewed its safety rules in the aftermath of the fire.
examples.zh: 火災過後，學校檢討了安全規範。

examples.en: The company is still dealing with the aftermath of the mistake.
examples.zh: 公司仍在處理那個錯誤所帶來的後果。

examples.en: Scratching the rash will only aggravate it.
examples.zh: 抓皮膚疹只會讓它更嚴重。

examples.en: Loud noise can aggravate a headache, so she rested in silence.
examples.zh: 吵雜的聲音可能讓頭痛加劇，所以她安靜地休息。

examples.en: His constant complaints began to aggravate his roommates.
examples.zh: 他不斷的抱怨開始惹惱他的室友。

examples.en: The aggregate of the two scores decided the winner.
examples.zh: 兩次成績的總分決定了贏家。

examples.en: In the aggregate, sales rose by ten percent.
examples.zh: 整體來看，銷售量上升了百分之十。

examples.en: The total is an aggregate of donations from many families.
examples.zh: 這筆總額是許多家庭捐款的合計。

examples.en: The aggregate score of both games was 5 to 3.
examples.zh: 兩場比賽的總比數是五比三。

examples.en: The aggregate cost of the trip was higher than we planned.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行的總花費比我們計畫的高。

examples.en: Aggregate sales for the year reached a new record.
examples.zh: 本年度的總銷售額創下新紀錄。

examples.en: Regular exercise can slow down aging and help people stay active.
examples.zh: 規律運動可以減緩老化，幫助人們維持活力。

examples.en: Aging is a natural part of life.
examples.zh: 老化是生命中很自然的一部分。

examples.en: This cream is made to reduce the signs of aging.
examples.zh: 這款乳霜是為了減少老化的跡象而製作的。

examples.en: Taiwan has an aging population, which increases the demand for elder care.
examples.zh: 台灣面臨人口老化，對長者照護的需求因而增加。

examples.en: My aging grandfather still walks in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我年邁的爺爺每天早上仍在公園散步。

examples.en: The aging bridge needs to be repaired soon.
examples.zh: 這座老舊的橋很快就需要修復。

examples.en: The loud noise began to agitate the baby.
examples.zh: 吵鬧的聲音開始讓寶寶不安。

examples.en: The washing machine agitates the clothes to remove dirt.
examples.zh: 洗衣機攪動衣物，以去除汙垢。

examples.en: Some students agitate for a longer lunch break.
examples.zh: 有些學生積極倡議延長午休時間。
